verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers AI-based semantic extraction through `ai_query` and `ai_extract_rules`, so choosing the extraction model is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the docs shows a way to point that extraction at a local or self-hosted LLM; it appears to run only on ScrapingBee's hosted backend. Community comments about 'running something locally' mean replacing ScrapingBee altogether, not swapping its LLM backend, so they do not count here.
